_doc: THE canonical release mix, as relative ratios. One table, read by everything that has an opinion about how much of each partition a release should contain. Ratios rather than shares so registering or retiring a partition renormalizes the rest instead of leaving every other row wrong until somebody re-sums them by hand.
_ratio_zero: A partition that should get none of the release is RETIRED from the partition registry, never zeroed here. A zero ratio leaves it registered, floored, censused and permanently starved, which reads downstream as a measured absence of demand.
